ambient_events: A drawer comes out an inch, is looked into, and goes back.
The thermometer is read and a number is written in the log.
It is very cold in here and very still and the stillness is the point.
description: Half sunk into the ground with a turf roof over it and a heavy door set into the slope. A thermometer is screwed to the door frame and a log hangs beside it on a string, and both of them are read twice a day.
name: The Seed Vault
